name: Kavisha Sarma
bio: Kavisha was born in Sydney, Australia. She completed a dual Bachelor of Commerce/ Bachelor of Advanced Science (Honours) at the University of New South Wales where she spent her Honours research focused on lanthanide single ion magnets under the supervision of Dr Scott Sulway. She is currently completing her PhD at the University of New South Wales under the supervision of Prof. Jon Beves focusing on light-controlled coordination compounds.
education: PhD Student, University of New South Wales (2023 - present)
Bachelor of Commerce/ Bachelor of Advanced Science (Honours Class 1) University of New South Wales (2018-2022)
awards: School of Chemistry Award for best third year PhD talk)
